title: Masu Karya Alkawari da Aka Kora
intro: A farkon zamanin wata al'umma mai tasowa, wata ƙabila ta taɓa zama a gidaje masu ƙarfi, waɗanda aka ɗaure da yarjejeniya. Lokacin da aka ci amanar wannan yarjejeniya, sakamakon ya bayyana a shafukan Alƙur'ani. Su waye waɗannan mutanen, kuma me ya faru da gidajensu da gonakinsu?
clues: Mun zauna a cikin kagara masu ƙarfi waɗanda suka ba mu rashin kwanciyar hankali.
Mu mutanen Littafi ne, duk da haka mun karya alkawarinmu.
Mun yi makirci a kan manzo bayan ya zo mana, amma makircinmu ya gaza.
An sare bishiyoyin dabinonmu da umarnin Allah, alamar ikonsa.
An kore mu daga gidajenmu, ba za mu sake dawowa ba, a matsayin hukunci saboda rashin biyayyarmu.
Alqur'ani ya ambace mu a cikin babin taron, kuma labarinmu ya zama gargaɗi ga waɗanda suka karya yarjejeniya.

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
